name: Friends Academy Summer Programs
description_short: Day camps for ages 3-16 on Friends Academy's 65-acre campus in North Dartmouth, with more than 40 full-day and half-day options: the general Summer Friends camp, creative, enrichment and sports camps, a counselor-in-training program, and academic camps for students with language-based learning differences.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable ($125 half-day, $200 full-day, $425 SBP/CIT). If you cancel before Friday, May 29, you get back everything except the deposit. After May 29, you pay the full cost. Camps canceled for low enrollment are fully refunded. Medical cancellations with a doctor's note get a partial refund. Changing to a different week costs $25. Changing within the same week is free.
special_needs_notes: Sally Borden Program (SBP) Academic Camps: 6-week summer courses in math, writing and structured literacy for grades 1-8 with language-based learning differences and/or vulnerabilities, taught by educators trained in Orton-Gillingham.

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 22 – August 21, 2026), which is already over as of 2026-10-13. 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet.

Each camp has its own price: Summer Friends full day $450/week; Little Friends $450 full day / $300 half day; Creative/Enrichment/Sports $500 full day / $300 half day; Summer Friends afternoon add-on $200/week; CIT $1,215 for 3 weeks; Surround Care $85/week or $20/day drop-in. The price_min shown excludes the add-on and Surround Care.
There's a 12% discount for booking 4+ weeks of full-day Summer Friends or Little Friends, or 4+ weeks of Summer Friends afternoons.
No session list was recorded because individual weeks and dates are on the category sub-pages.
